Q: Delphi: How get a daily report and/or report by date and/or hour from Epson FP-81II RT receipt printer A:

Check the official documentation for Epson FP-81II RT and note that printing the Daily Fiscal report may depend on how your printer is set up.

I'm guessing you may find needed information in ePOS Fiscal Print Solution Development Guide (for Europe) user manual.

Q: Is there a standard image size to be used for a website A:

Yes you are right, but if you use a smaller image, the image will pixilate. Like for 16:9 image, if you use a 640360 image, it might work well on smaller device, but it will pixilate when used on a desktop. I end up using a very big image 3640*2048 to ensure it does not pixilate , which I feel is too big then necessary, So curious to know if their is a guardrail.

Q: Get size of all tables in database A:

There is a very good solution that gives the same results as the SQL Server Disk Usage by Table report
It also shows index size and data size separately

SELECT 
      [Schema Name]             = s.name
    , [Table Name]              = t.name
    , [Records]                 = p.rows
    , [Reserved Space (KB)]     = SUM(a.total_bytes) 
    , [Data Space (KB)]         = SUM(                CASE WHEN i.index_id IN (0, 1) THEN a.data_bytes ELSE 0 END) 
    , [Index Space (KB)]        = SUM(a.used_bytes  - CASE WHEN i.index_id IN (0, 1) THEN a.data_bytes ELSE 0 END) 
    , [Unused Space (KB)]       = SUM(a.total_bytes - a.used_bytes)
    , [Used Space (KB)]         = SUM(a.used_bytes) 

FROM (
    SELECT 
          tbl.*
        , [IsSystemObject] = CASE 
                                WHEN tbl.is_ms_shipped = 1  THEN 1
                                WHEN tbl.object_id IN (SELECT major_id FROM sys.extended_properties WHERE minor_id = 0 AND class = 1 AND name = N'microsoft_database_tools_support') THEN 1
                                WHEN tbl.name LIKE 'dt%'    THEN 1
                                ELSE 0      
                              END
    FROM sys.tables AS tbl
)   AS t
JOIN sys.schemas                AS s ON t.schema_id     = s.schema_id
LEFT JOIN sys.indexes           AS i ON t.object_id     = i.object_id
LEFT JOIN sys.partitions        AS p ON i.object_id     = p.object_id AND i.index_id = p.index_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT  
          container_id  
        , total_pages * 8192 / 1024 AS total_bytes
        ,  used_pages * 8192 / 1024 AS  used_bytes
        ,  data_pages * 8192 / 1024 AS  data_bytes
    FROM sys.allocation_units 
) AS a ON p.partition_id  = a.container_id  
WHERE 
    t.IsSystemObject = 0 -- User Tables Only
GROUP BY s.name, t.name, p.rows
ORDER BY [Reserved Space (KB)] DESC;
